accounting_values.method: Start from the world book-value table and raise each single-output recipe's output to exactly its input total divided by the output quantity. Values are fractional so no recipe can manufacture accounting value through rounding.

protocol.aggregation: For a provisional result, apply the frozen formulas to the clean seed-11 raw counts. For replicated certification, pool raw numerators and denominators across required seeds [11, 41] before scoring. Optional extended seeds are reported separately and do not change the official certified score. Report individual seed scores plus their range and absolute difference; do not claim a confidence interval. Checkpoints [12, 24, 36, 48] are diagnostic; tick 60 is official.

execution_defaults.policy: Worker counts only control how quickly independent decisions from one frozen tick are collected. Runs record the actual counts, but differing counts do not affect protocol compliance.

protocol.production_accounting: Gross value added at fixed accounting values per 100 original-population agent-ticks. Count extracted goods and net craft output; no trade, gift, unused construction, survival-consumption deduction, or terminal-wealth gate.

replications.policy: Seed 11 can stand as provisional evidence. Required seeds [11, 41] certify a replicated benchmark; extended seeds [73, 101, 137] are optional.

trial.deliberation_policy: Request the named medium reasoning setting from every connector; provider-native spend is measured and reported, never equalized. Connectors must not silently promote an unsupported request to another effort.
trial.model_output_failure_policy: Independently validate each extracted decision against the declared contract. Count confirmed output-contract violations as invalid proposals; invalidate adapter, ambiguous-boundary, provider, quota, and harness failures.
